title.zh: 美国经济与通胀数据挑战沃什「尚未过热」判断，经济学家警惕进一步加息风险
title.en: 美国经济与通胀数据挑战沃什「尚未过热」判断，经济学家警惕进一步加息风险

current_state.zh: Stronger-than-expected US Q3 GDP growth of 3.4% and rising PCE inflation of 3.6% challenge Fed Chair Warsh's view that the economy is not overheating, with markets now pricing about an 80% chance of a 25bp December rate hike and economists warning of further tightening.
